names.form: Άγιοι Δέκα μάρτυρες οι ἐν Φοινίκῃ
names.note: saint.gr gives no name for any of the ten, so its line for 16 Μαρτίου is kept whole, as the corpus keeps «Άγιοι Έξι Μάρτυρες» for another nameless company.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding menologion day (30 September 2026).
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (30 September 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 16ης Μαρτίου — «Άγιοι Δέκα μάρτυρες οι ἐν Φοινίκῃ»

attestations.note: The whole of the page is one sentence, «Οι Άγιοι αυτοί Δέκα μάρτυρες, μαρτύρησαν δια ξίφους» — these ten holy martyrs were martyred by the sword — with two lines of verse. It names nobody, enumerates nobody, gives no year and prints no hymn, so the company is kept as one entry.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding menologion day (30 September 2026).
